tests.assertion: Initial fixture issue carried exactly one category label and one state label.
Additive transition labels did not remove prior roles; the issue carried two category labels and two state labels.
Explicit removal of the prior labels restored one category and one state role.

limitations: The connector exposes additive label operations and explicit removal, but not the triage skill's agent decision-making. This promotes only the external tracker invariant/weakness, not prompt adherence.
